# Copilot Instructions - Stefan Drazic Fitness Coaching Website

## Project Overview
This is a professional fitness coaching website built with TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. The site includes three main pages:
- Home page with hero section and fitness coaching information
- Privacy Policy page
- Terms & Conditions page

All pages feature:
- Sticky navigation menu linking to all three pages
- Responsive footer with placeholders for business contact info
- Modern gradient design with purple and green accents
- Mobile-responsive layout

## Key Files
- `index.html` - Home page with hero section and CTA button
- `privacy-policy.html` - Privacy policy (editable template)
- `terms.html` - Terms and conditions (editable template)
- `src/main.ts` - TypeScript application entry point
- `src/styles.css` - Global styles and responsive design
- `tsconfig.json` - TypeScript compiler configuration
- `package.json` - Project dependencies and scripts

## Current Status
✅ Project structure created

## Next Steps (if needed)
- Run `npm install` to install dependencies
- Run `npm run build` to compile TypeScript
- Update footer placeholders with actual contact information
- Integrate booking system (Calendly, Acuity, etc.)
- Add actual business content and testimonials
- Deploy to hosting platform

## Contact Information Placeholders
The following need to be filled in across all pages:
- `[Your Email Here]` - Replace with contact email
- `[Your Address Here]` - Replace with business address

## Notes for Future Development
- The `bookCall()` function in both HTML and TypeScript is a placeholder
- Consider integrating with a booking platform like Calendly
- Add analytics tracking to the `trackEvent()` function
